notes.title: Insurgence - Second Assault, Less Than 12 Hours!
notes.content:
Our game, CZAR, will be published by YSY Softworks and we are not alone!
We also helping Platonic Game Studio (who Co-Publish our game) in making a game sequel for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/912930/Insurgence__Chains_of_Renegade/]Insurgence Chains of Renegade[/url], it's Insurgence Second Assault and they will be released tomorrow!
This story rich 2D JRPG with unique and original skills system coming soon Worldwide on 27 February 2020!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1081100/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/0cba8cd507226e411bc810e280a2c508606f6a1a.jpg[/img][/url]

Release Time:

[b]US Time[/b]
07:00 US PST | 10:00 US EST

[b]European[/b]
15:00 GMT

[b]Asia & SEA[/b]
22:00 Bangkok, Hanoi, Jakarta |
23:00 Singapore, Manila, Beijing

Take a note that they will have an [i][b]Early Bird Package DLC[/b][/i] when Insurgence - Second Assault release for [b]FREE![/b] 
It will only for 30 Days, a special presents for Early Adopters of the game.
After 30 days, this package will either completely disappear or become paid content.

It will contains:
- Post Card in A5 and A6 Format 300Dpi for Prints.
- Mini Album containing 6 In-Game Music and 2 Bonus Track from Other YSY Softworks Games, Composed by SHIDO STRIFE
- Wallpaper in FHD, WQHD, and 4K
- Special Notes from Developer.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1081100/]CLICK HERE TO CHECK'EM UP AND ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST![/url]

Also be sure to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252310/Insurgence__Second_Assault_Early_Bird_Package/]Early Bird Package for FREE[/url] to your wishlist!
